name: @sjawhar/pi-legion
//: Test guards. The `test` script's first command runs `bun test --parallel=4 --path-ignore-patterns 'scripts/skill-scenarios/score.test.ts'`, which sets no --timeout: test-timeout-preload.ts declares 300000 ms inside each worker (setDefaultTimeout + @legion/test-fixtures/deadline declareGuard), and a plain `bun test` keeps Bun's 5000 ms (bunfig.toml). The cold role-pane row of extensions/legion-background-subagent-omp.test.ts needs more than 5000 ms in every mode (a cold Oh My Pi pane start and NATS registration read 5-6 s unloaded), so it takes COLD_PANE_GUARD_MS = 300000 of its own: useRowGuard for the shared wait, `test`'s third argument for Bun's row kill, and the afterEach's own hook timeout, whose raw-await cleanup (killing omp, stopping the stub server) also outlasts 5000 ms under load. The value is well above twice the reading, for dev-box load.

test, its second command: runs scripts/skill-scenarios/score.test.ts alone (no --parallel, so test-timeout-preload.ts declares nothing and bunfig's row-deadline preload still marks each row) at --timeout 1110000, six times, rounded up, the most its beforeAll hooks can take at the calibrated load. Over 20 runs of the command at the 96 rung (Job infra-1580-r31sc2-zcqqg of the cluster's builds namespace, two CPUs and 8 GiB, 120 busy loops, row A 38.5 s, at 97bc3646), 20 of 20, a run spent at most 184 410 ms outside its rows: the staging drain, the scoring run and the file's load together (and 178 861 ms at 9f640966, -r33sc2-z9zgq). Bun reports no hook's time apart, so that sum bounds each hook. The slowest row, live-read, took 35 108 ms. That is inside the pi-legion job's room for one hang: its 28 minutes less the 416 s its workflow records, which counts this command's own run in CI (at most 20 s in main's merge-group runs 45723571545, 45721434343 and 45721301880), 1 264 s.
